use_case_name: Share a Geographic Pointer with Other Units

claims.content: A J7.3 message provides the capability for C² JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C² JU's displays.

goal.raw_text: A J7.3 message provides the capability for C² JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C² JU's displays.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has a geographic position to designate.
The C2 JU has up to twenty characters of text to accompany the geographic designation.
The target display unit(s) (one or more C² JU's displays) are available to receive the J7.3 message.
If addressing multiple JUs, the system is prepared to construct J7.3C1 Pointer Additional Addresses continuation words as needed.
If specifying operator positions by function within a JU, the pointer action data element is available for use.
The C2 JU initiates the transmission of a J7.3 message to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C² JU's displays.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU initiates the transmission of a J7.3 message to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C² JU's displays.

claims.content: The C2 JU constructs a J7.3 message to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text.
If the message is addressed to one JU, the C2 JU places the specific address in the J7.3I Pointer initial word.

If the message is addressed to multiple JUs, the C2 JU places one address in the J7.3I word and uses the J7.3C1 Pointer Additional Addresses continuation word to contain up to four additional addresses.
If more than five addresses are required, the C2 JU sends multiple J7.3C1 words.
If the message is addressed to all JUs, the C2 JU places the collective address in the J7.3I word.
The C2 JU uses the J7.3C2 and J7.3C3 words to provide amplifying textual information of up to twenty characters.
If specifying operator positions by function within a JU, the C2 JU uses the pointer action data element.
The C2 JU transmits the J7.3 message; since no TN is assigned to the pointer, it must be displayed and dropped by local procedure at the receiving unit(s).
If the own unit MY field is set to value 0, 1, or 3, discontinue transmission of the own unit J7.2 message and process the received message in accordance with rules 4.7.2.2 a through h.
If the own unit MY field is set to value 2, complete the transmission of the message sequence in progress.
The geographic position and up to twenty characters of text are displayed on the designated C² JU's displays.
If addressed to one JU, the specific address is contained in the J7.3I Pointer initial word.

If addressed to multiple JUs, the J7.3I word contains one address and J7.3C1 Pointer Additional Addresses continuation words contain up to four additional addresses per word; multiple J7.3C1 words may be sent for more than five addresses.
If addressed to all JUs, the collective address is contained in the J7.3I word.
Amplifying textual information of up to twenty characters is provided via J7.3C2 and J7.3C3 words.
If operator positions by function within a JU were specified, the pointer action data element was used to designate them.
The pointer message is displayed and dropped by local procedure at receiving units, as no TN is assigned to the pointer.
